Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Lupo, the Anarch, plays Dust Up to hit Marcus Vitel with his hands for 3 damage. Marcus Vitel playes Autonomic Mastery. Does Marcus Vitel take the 3 damage before combat ends?

Name: Autonomic Mastery
[LotN:U, HttB:PKia]
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Dominate
Only usable at close range.
[dom] Strike: burn the opposing non-wraith ally or a non-wraith retainer on the opposing minion.
[DOM] Strike: hand strike. Damage from this strike is reduced to zero. Combat ends immediately after this strike resolves, unless it is dodged. Only usable in combat with a non-wraith ally or a younger vampire.
Artist: Peter Bergting

Messages.Author: Kilrauko
Messages.Body:
> XZealot wrote:
> Lupo, the Anarch, plays Dust Up to hit Marcus Vitel with his hands for 3 damage. Marcus Vitel playes Autonomic Mastery. Does Marcus Vitel take the 3 damage before combat ends?
>
Yes.

LSJ answered similar question where speed of strikes (both strike:hand strike) was the same but the amount of damage was different with the following. If there's been change since then I'm sure to be corrected.

groups.google.com/d/msg/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/2fFyhL6YqI0/-zsMEGtt4qEJ
